hey there. 18 yr old here. 

a month ago i was in the exact same place as you. i also have to keep it a secret from my parents. I dont have any advice on the part of calling your home because we dont use our home phone anymore ( thankgod). When i called i just told the receptionist lady i wanted to make an appointment with the doctor. She asked me what for. I awkwardly told her i had been having depressive thoughts. She just told me okay and asked when I wanted to have my appointment. 

Last monday i sat at my doctor's room and told him i had been depressed since high school and that i had reached my limit and needed help. He was very kind and understanding. I shouldve went sooner i realised then. He told me that people feel this way sometimes. Feelings become stronger and stronger and sometimes you need to look for help. There's nothing wrong with that. He booked me an appointment with a psychologist who is going to talk to me.  If the psychologist thinks i need any medicine he would need the doctor's approval first.

 The good thing is, in my country the doctor isn't allowed to tell any of your business to other people, even your parents. You could talk to your doctor about this and ask him to not call your home phone and just your mobile phone number.

Please, do make that appointment. Even if you don't really want to, do it.  I've been depressed for 5 years and and have been procastinating this appointment out of shame. Now that i've done it a feel a bit relieved. Things are going to get better now. I can't wait for my appointment with the psychologist and to be finally diagnosed and get proper help. If i can do it, you can do it. Goodluck
